# Clavia Trace Index

Clavia Trace Index is a read-only analysis interface for immutable agent trajectories. Use the public API or MCP server to list datasets, query aggregate behavior, and inspect redacted traces.

## Interface

- Analysis compares behavior, model outcomes, and tool use.
- Traces starts with a collapsed activity tree. Open a phase and turn to reach raw evidence. A linear record is also available.
- Shared views enforce the partner-review or lab-prospect redaction policy on the server.

## API discovery

- [Current session](/v1/session): Lists visible datasets, views, and policy capabilities.
- [Service health](/health): Reports whether the trace service is available.
